Episode in partnership with ReRack!
After weeks of deadlines, dilemmas, and heartbreaks, Ray and Nikhat are finally hitting pause. No work calls. No awkward conversations. Just a weekend away — and a much-needed breath of fresh air.
This episode is all about friendship resets, emotional reflection, and rediscovering the joy of simply being — far away from responsibilities and reality.
Starring Aisha Ahmed, Yashaswini Dayama, Viraj Ghelani, and Rohan Khurana, this chapter offers a heartfelt reminder that sometimes, the best therapy is a road trip with your person.
